description: This file contains Kotlin classes implementing adapters for RecyclerViews in an Android grocery shopping app. It defines adapters for product grid, cart items, and orders, managing how data is displayed in the UI.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying a grid of products, supporting item click and add-to-cart actions.

classes.name: CartAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying cart items, supporting quantity changes and removal.

classes.name: OrdersAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying list of orders.

classes.name: Diff
classes.description: Object implementing DiffUtil for efficient list updates for each adapter.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for each adapter, managing individual item views.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates item layouts and creates ViewHolder instances.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolders for display.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits new list data to the adapter.
